title: Serverhop
features: serverhop uses api https://playvora.vercel.app/roblox to fix cant parse json errors
script:
getfenv().hasrun = getfenv().hasrun or false
if getfenv().hasrun then return end
getfenv().hasrun = true

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local PlaceId = game.PlaceId
local CurrentJobId = game.JobId

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

httprequest = syn and syn.request or request or http_request or fluxus and fluxus.request or httprequest

local function ServerHop()
    if not httprequest then
        warn("No httprequest supported")
        return
    end

    while true do
        local Servers = {}

        local Success, Response = pcall(function()
            return httprequest({Url = "https://playvora.vercel.app/roblox?gameid=" .. PlaceId})
        end)

        if Success and Response and Response.Body then
            local Data = HttpService:JSONDecode(Response.Body)
            if Data and Data.data then
                for _, Server in ipairs(Data.data) do
                    if Server.id ~= CurrentJobId and Server.playing and Server.maxPlayers then
                        local FillPercent = Server.playing / Server.maxPlayers * 100
                        if FillPercent >= 10 and FillPercent <= 95 then
                            table.insert(Servers, Server.id)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if #Servers > 0 then
            local Target = Servers[math.random(#Servers)]
            print("Hopping to server -> " .. Target)
            TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(PlaceId, Target, LocalPlayer)
            break
        end

        task.wait(3)
    end
end

ServerHop()
